{{Quote|A specialist MO-7 science officer could examine the converters to determine their source. We have such an officer on staff. I will notify him while you search the last coordinates.|Elara Dorne|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
An '''MO-7 science officer''' was a specialized type of science officer in the [[Republic Army]]. One was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] at [[Olaris]], and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Elara Dorne]] enlisted the officer's aid to study several sets of abandoned [[Power converter/Legends|power converters]].
